requirements.Title: HP’s First Business Ink Tank Printer
requirements.Description: Develop and launch HP's first business ink tank printer specifically targeted at unmanaged and lightly managed SMBs (5-250 employees, 6-15 printers, AMPV ~500 pages).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a gap in HP's portfolio (CISS PLE segment) and meets evolving customer needs for ROI, efficiency, and cost-effective printing.
requirements.Dependencies: Must align with SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal; warranty and serviceability requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is launched and available for SMB customers; achieves targeted monthly sales run rate (20-30K units); receives positive feedback from target segment.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity, Scan Workflow & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity, scan workflow, and manageability features to make managing SMB business printing easier.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates HP from competitors, addresses key pain points for non-IT SMB decision makers, and supports solutions enhancement with AI.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires consolidated SMB portal; must support PaaS and device management features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features implemented for print, scan, and support; validated through user testing; measurable improvement in productivity and manageability.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO with Minimal Intervention
requirements.Description: Design the printer to deliver HP's lowest business total cost of ownership (TCO) with minimal user intervention required.
requirements.Rationale: Key purchase driver for SMBs seeking ROI and efficiency; competitive advantage over alternatives.
requirements.Dependencies: Must support keyed bottles, maintenance-free claims, and sustainability requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO calculations show HP is lowest among competitors; minimal maintenance demonstrated in field trials; user feedback confirms ease of use.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Customer Replaceable Parts
requirements.Description: Printer must be designed for easy serviceability, with key components (PHA, maintenance box) being customer replaceable if out of warranty, and MINK replaceable at service centers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for SMBs without IT teams; supports post-purchase support and repurpose stages.
requirements.Dependencies: Warranty policy (80k pages or 2 years); maintenance-free design investigation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Serviceability features validated in design and user testing; parts are replaceable by customers as specified; meets warranty and service center requirements.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Supply
requirements.Description: Integrate keyed bottles to prevent incorrect ink filling and ensure ease of use for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and reduces errors for non-IT trained office managers; supports sustainability and supplies quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Must align with maintenance-free and sustainability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles implemented and validated through user testing; error rates reduced compared to previous models.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Printer Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for SMBs to manage their printers, including device management, AI solutions, and support.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the needs of unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs; differentiates HP through manageability and AI features.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with AI solutions and PaaS support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal operational and accessible for SMB customers; device management, AI, and support features available; user adoption metrics achieved.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Printer-as-a-Service)
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer supports Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS) models, including necessary telemetry and portal integration.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s strategic goal for PaaS acceleration and coverage; enables new business models and recurring revenue.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires telemetry requirements and portal integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is compatible with PaaS offerings; telemetry and portal features validated; business models enabled.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support and Speed Improvement
requirements.Description: For PDL SKU, ensure support for PDL/PS and improve speed to 25/20 min (current 25/19).
requirements.Rationale: Competitive positioning for medium and enterprise segments; addresses performance needs for SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Must align with Blue Angel certification and hardware specs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL/PS support implemented; speed improvement validated through testing; meets performance targets.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Ensure printer meets Blue Angel environmental certification requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Supports sustainability claims and competitive differentiation; important for global markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Must align with sustainability and hardware requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Blue Angel certification achieved; documentation available.

requirements.Title: Maintenance-Free or Reduced Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Design printer to be maintenance-free or require less maintenance (fewer parts to replace over life).
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes intervention for SMBs; increases reliability and customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Under investigation; must align with serviceability and sustainability requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance-free or reduced maintenance features validated; user feedback confirms reduced intervention.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% RCP (Recycled Content Plastic)
requirements.Description: Ensure printer uses at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), exceeding competitors (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s sustainability goals and provides a competitive advantage.
requirements.Dependencies: Must align with Blue Angel certification and supplies requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Material sourcing validated; sustainability claims substantiated; 60% RCP usage documented.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Integrate telemetry features to support device management, PaaS, and post-purchase support.
requirements.Rationale: Enables remote management, analytics, and support for SMBs; supports HP’s strategic goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires portal and PaaS integration; must meet privacy and compliance standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry features implemented and validated; data privacy and compliance requirements met.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Support mobile printing through the HP App for ease of use and accessibility.
requirements.Rationale: Meets customer expectations for modern office solutions; increases usability for SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Must integrate with SMB portal and device management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing feature operational; user feedback confirms ease of use.

requirements.Title: Solutions Monetization
requirements.Description: Enable monetization of solutions (AI, portal, services) as part of the printer offering.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s strategic goal for profitable growth and new revenue streams.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires portal and AI solutions integration; must comply with business models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Monetization features implemented; revenue targets achieved; business model validated.

requirements.Title: Consolidated Device Management Experience
requirements.Description: Provide a consolidated device management experience for SMBs, integrating AI, support, and telemetry.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates HP from competitors; addresses key SMB pain points around manageability and support.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires portal, AI, and telemetry integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device management features validated; user adoption metrics achieved; positive feedback from SMBs.
